newsitem.title: UZBEKISTAN: Australian WMC to firm Uzbek gold deal.
newsitem.headline: Australian WMC to firm Uzbek gold deal.

text.p: Australia's Western Mining Corporation (WMC) is to hammer out details next week of its $100 million gold project in the former Soviet republic of Uzbekistan, a company official said on Friday.

"We've made good progress so far," Jonathan Sanders, WMC representative in the Uzbek capital Tashkent, told Reuters, adding that a WMC delegation would meet officials from the State Committee for Geology and Mineral Resources on November 25.

WMC won a tender in September to develop the Zarmitan mine, located 90 km northwest of Samarkand. The mine contains around 24 million tonnes of auriferous ore with a rich grade of 10 grammes per tonne.
